caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional, framed arrangement of objects resembling a shadow box or diorama. The frame is rectangular and colored in shades of reddish-brown, set against a plain, off-white or beige background. Inside the frame, there is a composition of multiple pink flowers with green stems and leaves, arranged vertically and horizontally across the inner background, creating a dense floral pattern. Among the flowers, at the center-left part of the box, there is a bird with a brown body, blue wings, a black stripe, and a blue-tipped tail. The background within the frame is primarily green with lighter beige accents, forming the base for the flowers and bird. The flowers vary in shape, many resembling camellias or roses, with several having yellow centers, while others have small green circular details. The entire composition is contained within the dark pinkish-red frame, and the bottom right corner of the beige background outside the frame carries a small, handwritten signature, "I.F.E. McComb."
title: Valentine in Shadow Box
